comment: The body is a sine plus a fifth as much of its third harmonic (Snare.cpp:187). The wires are white noise through a bandpass at 2500Hz with a Q of 1, reset on every hit (Snare.cpp:155 to :158). The sweep knob is multiplied by 200 and added in hertz rather than as an exponent (Snare.cpp:120, :179), which is where the last Note comes from. The noise envelope coefficient uses half the rate of the body's (Snare.cpp:128, :130). The module is registered under the slug Lurer while its class and panel file are named Snare.
